item.title: Port strike halts shipments at major container terminal
item.description: A labor strike has stopped operations at a major container terminal, triggering shipping delays and port congestion across the region.

item.title: Factory shutdown after typhoon warning disrupts component supply
item.description: Manufacturers ordered a factory shutdown ahead of an approaching typhoon, raising fears of a component shortage downstream.

item.title: New tariff on imported parts pressures supplier logistics
item.description: A newly announced tariff is disrupting supplier logistics and prompting an embargo review by affected trade partners.

item.title: Congestion at Nhava Sheva delays India export shipments
item.description: Heavy container congestion at Nhava Sheva (JNPT) near Mumbai is delaying India export shipments of skincare and haircare goods, stretching lead times on the India-Europe lane to Rotterdam.

item.title: Chennai port operations slowed by heavy monsoon rains
item.description: Heavy monsoon rains have slowed container handling at the Port of Chennai, disrupting South India cosmetics and skincare exports and raising shipping delays across Asia trade lanes.

item.title: Local bakery wins regional dessert award
